video_title: Patrick Peterson Weighs In on Lane Kiffin’s CONTROVERSIAL LSU Move

quotes.speaker: Patrick Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Peterson defends Lane Kiffin's hiring as LSU head coach
quotes.excerpt: I think it was a great hire. I hate the fact that how the college schedule is set up.
quotes.quote: I think it was a great hire. I hate the fact that how the college schedule is set up to where he had to leave his team and all of that. And that was a bad look, but at the end of the day, he had to do that because he was going to a new opportunity. Signing day was a week away, so he has to be in the position to get guys. They don't have a coach, their program is up in shambles right now, so they got to get somebody in there to kind of get everything going.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Peterson discusses the coaching transition at Ohio State
quotes.excerpt: He's going to some Florida school, one of them, and he gets to stay.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Peterson
text_blocks.text: There's only one coach this year that's actually doing that. He took another job. Hartline.

text_blocks.speaker: Brice Butler
text_blocks.text: Yes, Ohio State. Exactly. He's going to some Florida school, one of them, and he gets to stay.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Peterson argues LSU is an upgrade over Ole Miss
quotes.excerpt: In my opinion, Ole Miss, you have nothing on LSU. This is an upgrade for this man.
quotes.quote: In my opinion, Ole Miss, you have nothing on LSU. This is an upgrade for this man. Who's going to say no to that? Nobody is saying no to an LSU job. 13 point whatever a year, second highest paid college head football coach, giving you $25 million to spend when you already have a program to where you have to go into the transfer portal to get players, you don't have the funds to actually get five stars into here. Like, I have to do pretty much all the legwork to get this program where it is to where now, all I have to do is worry about coaching.
